decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate is a flagship built directly on the firm's agricultural crate and injection-moulding know-how, so it can interpret several harvest seasons of feedback and keep refining it in-house, although its absence from the website in 2020–2021 raises some doubt.

The medium-duty rackable pallet extends the firm's core pallet engineering and serves pooling and industrial customers it understands well, so its results are easy to read and improve, though it went unobserved on the website in 2020–2021.

The spill-retention pallet is a niche safety product that sits further from the firm's core logistics knowledge and has not been visible since 2018, so its resources are better redirected to core reusable packaging development.
The pallet with load retainers is a minor variant that adds little new learning and has disappeared from the website, so folding it back into the standard pallet range frees engineering capacity.
